title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web /…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Gutenberg Blocks by Kadence Blocks up to version 3.9.1.1. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of affected users. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
